lines.zh: 我踩着落叶走，脚下没有声音。
lines.en: I walk on fallen leaves and my steps make no sound.

lines.zh: 树枝刮过我的脸，我不躲。
lines.en: Branches scrape my face and I do not duck.

lines.zh: 我在树干之间穿行，肩膀擦出木屑。
lines.en: I weave between trunks, scraping wood dust off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的腿僵，可我知道该往哪走。
lines.en: My legs are stiff, but I know where I am going.

lines.zh: 腐肉在袋里撞着土豆，一路响。
lines.en: Rotten flesh knocks against potatoes in my pouch all the way.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，是为了不惊动前面的鹿。
lines.en: I walk slowly so I do not startle the deer ahead.

lines.zh: 苔藓被我踩塌，露出底下的黑土。
lines.en: I crush the moss and bare black soil shows beneath.

lines.zh: 我拖着一只脚，落叶被犁出一道沟。
lines.en: I drag one foot and plow a furrow through the leaves.

lines.zh: 林子里暗，我的眼睛反而好用。
lines.en: The woods are dark, which only helps my eyes.

lines.zh: 我沿着兽径走，这条路上有味道。
lines.en: I follow a game trail; there is a smell along it.

lines.zh: 我抬手拨开藤，指节上裂了口。
lines.en: I push a vine aside and the knuckle splits open.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，可从不绕开挡路的东西。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but I never step around what blocks me.

lines.zh: 我站在树影里，等一个路过的。
lines.en: I stand in tree shade waiting for someone to pass.

lines.zh: 袋里的土豆发了芽，我懒得管。
lines.en: The potatoes in my pouch have sprouted and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我把腐肉翻了个面，让它晒晒。
lines.en: I turn the rotten flesh over to let it dry a little.

lines.zh: 铁锭硌着我的胯骨，习惯了。
lines.en: The iron ingot digs into my hip; I am used to it.

lines.zh: 我听见啄木鸟，数了十七下。
lines.en: I hear a woodpecker and count seventeen knocks.

lines.zh: 我的手臂会自己抽一下，像在试力气。
lines.en: My arm twitches on its own, as if testing its strength.

lines.zh: 叶子落在我头上，我没有拂掉。
lines.en: A leaf lands on my head and I do not brush it off.

lines.zh: 我靠着树，树皮被我蹭下一块。
lines.en: I lean on a tree and rub a patch of bark off it.

lines.zh: 林子里没有风，腐肉的味道散不开。
lines.en: There is no wind in the woods, so the stink stays put.

lines.zh: 我数着袋子里的东西，少了一块。
lines.en: I count what is in the pouch: one piece short.

lines.zh: 我从树后看你，只露出半张脸。
lines.en: I watch you from behind a tree with half my face showing.

lines.zh: 你脚下那根枯枝，响得整片林子都听见。
lines.en: That dry twig under your foot cracked loud enough for the whole wood.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，看有没有盾。
lines.en: I watch your hands to see if you carry a shield.

lines.zh: 你离我大概十步，正好。
lines.en: You are about ten paces off: perfect.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处发亮，你看得见。
lines.en: My eyes glow in the dark, and you can see them.

lines.zh: 我记得你这件衣服的颜色。
lines.en: I remember the color of that shirt of yours.

lines.zh: 你往树后躲，我就换个角度。
lines.en: You hide behind a tree, so I shift my angle.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，眼皮早就干了。
lines.en: I do not blink; my eyelids dried out long ago.

lines.zh: 你手里那把斧头，我记下了。
lines.en: That axe in your hand, I have noted it.

lines.zh: 我歪了下头，脖子发出响声。
lines.en: I tilt my head and my neck cracks.

lines.zh: 我挨了一刀，木屑一样的碎肉掉下来。
lines.en: I take a cut and splinters of flesh drop off me.

lines.zh: 疼来得慢，像树汁往外渗。
lines.en: The pain comes slowly, like sap seeping out.

lines.zh: 你砍进我的肩，刀卡了一下。
lines.en: You cut into my shoulder and the blade sticks briefly.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，脚跟压断了枯枝。
lines.en: I step back and my heel snaps a dry twig.

lines.zh: 我的伤口是干的，几乎不流血。
lines.en: My wound is dry and barely bleeds.

lines.zh: 这一下震得我脑中嗡嗡直响。
lines.en: That blow leaves a ringing deep inside my skull.

lines.zh: 我扶住树，树皮被我抓出痕。
lines.en: I grip a tree and leave marks in the bark.

lines.zh: 我的手臂垂下来，又慢慢抬起。
lines.en: My arm drops, then slowly lifts again.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的指节，我还是握着。
lines.en: You break a knuckle and I keep my grip.

lines.zh: 我倒进灌木，叶子沾满伤口。
lines.en: I fall into the brush and leaves cling to the wound.

lines.zh: 面包举得再高，我也只盯你的指头。
lines.en: Raise the bread as high as you like; I watch your fingers.

lines.zh: 我不吃新鲜的，那会让我恶心。
lines.en: I do not eat fresh food; it turns my stomach.

lines.zh: 别用吃的引我，我袋里还有土豆。
lines.en: Do not lure me with food; I still have potatoes.

lines.zh: 我饿，可我更想把手里的东西扔出去。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I would rather throw what I hold.

lines.zh: 你挪近半步，我便退到树后去。
lines.en: Take half a step closer and I am behind the tree.

lines.zh: 那种甜味太软了，我咬不动。
lines.en: That sweetness is too soft; I cannot bite it.

lines.zh: 你把东西放在地上，我也不捡。
lines.en: Even if you set it on the ground, I will not pick it up.

lines.zh: 会喘气会跑的东西，才值得我抬手。
lines.en: Only things that breathe and run are worth raising my arm for.

lines.zh: 我摇了摇头，落叶从肩上掉下来。
lines.en: I shake my head and leaves fall off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，你留着当晚饭。
lines.en: Put it away; save it for your own supper.

lines.zh: 你撞在我胸口，像撞上一段木头。
lines.en: You hit my chest like hitting a length of timber.

lines.zh: 我身上的腐肉味一下子扑到你脸上。
lines.en: The stink of my flesh hits your face at once.

lines.zh: 我们撞开，我顺手扶了下树。
lines.en: We bounce apart and I catch myself on a tree.

lines.zh: 我的肩胛骨很硬，你的手会疼。
lines.en: My shoulder blade is hard; your hand will hurt.

lines.zh: 我一个踉跄，踩烂了一朵蘑菇。
lines.en: I stumble and crush a mushroom underfoot.

lines.zh: 你退开时，衣服上沾了一片烂肉。
lines.en: As you pull away, a scrap of flesh sticks to your clothes.

lines.zh: 我不道歉，我只是站着不动。
lines.en: I do not apologize; I just stand still.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我袋子响了。
lines.en: That bump made my pouch rattle.

lines.zh: 你别从背后过来，我会转身。
lines.en: Do not come from behind; I will turn around.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一步，谁也没让。
lines.en: A step apart, neither of us gives way.

lines.zh: 林子里没有别的投手，只有我。
lines.en: There is no other lobber in these woods, only me.

lines.zh: 你问错了对象，我连自己都管不好。
lines.en: You are asking the wrong one; I cannot even manage myself.

lines.zh: 我这样的身子，抱不住谁。
lines.en: With a body like this, I cannot hold anyone.

lines.zh: 那种事要热的血，我的早凉了。
lines.en: That takes hot blood, and mine went cold.

lines.zh: 我只跟这些树待着，它们不嫌我。
lines.en: I keep to these trees; they do not mind me.

lines.zh: 我的同类都散在林子里，各走各的。
lines.en: My kind are scattered through the woods, each alone.

lines.zh: 别问了，腐肉的味道已经够我受。
lines.en: Stop asking; the smell of rotten flesh is enough for me.

lines.zh: 我没有巢，也没有等我的。
lines.en: I have no nest, and no one waiting for me.

lines.zh: 你把这话说给活人听吧。
lines.en: Save those words for the living.

lines.zh: 我低头看了看袋子，那里才是我的伴。
lines.en: I look down at my pouch; that is my company.

lines.zh: 我捡起一颗土豆，擦掉泥就塞进袋。
lines.en: I pick up a potato, wipe off the mud, and pocket it.

lines.zh: 铁锭有点沉，我掂了掂才收好。
lines.en: The iron ingot is heavy; I weigh it before keeping it.

lines.zh: 这块腐肉还软，正适合扔。
lines.en: This flesh is still soft, just right for throwing.

lines.zh: 我弯腰很慢，膝盖响了一声。
lines.en: I bend slowly and my knee pops once.

lines.zh: 有毒的那颗土豆，我单独放着。
lines.en: The poisonous potato I keep in a separate spot.

lines.zh: 地上有别人掉的东西，我先闻再捡。
lines.en: Something dropped on the ground; I sniff it before taking it.

lines.zh: 我捡东西时手指不太听话。
lines.en: My fingers do not quite obey when I pick things up.

lines.zh: 我又捡了一块，袋子快满了。
lines.en: I pick up one more and the pouch is nearly full.

lines.zh: 我把铁锭换到外侧，方便摸。
lines.en: I move the iron to the outside where I can feel it.

lines.zh: 这东西不能扔，但可以留着。
lines.en: This one cannot be thrown, but it can be kept.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，脚就自己停了。
lines.en: I see you and my feet stop on their own.

lines.zh: 我不追，我只需要一个角度。
lines.en: I do not chase; I only need an angle.

lines.zh: 你站在两棵树中间，很难躲。
lines.en: You stand between two trees, with little room to dodge.

lines.zh: 我把手伸进袋子，摸到最软的那块。
lines.en: I reach into the pouch and find the softest piece.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁的味道，我要那东西。
lines.en: You carry the smell of iron, and I want it.

lines.zh: 这个距离我练过很多次。
lines.en: I have practiced this distance many times.

lines.zh: 我从树后挪出来半步，你就看见我了。
lines.en: I shift half a step from the tree and you spot me.

lines.zh: 你若是跑，我就往你前面扔。
lines.en: If you run, I will throw ahead of you.

lines.zh: 我选你，因为你带着光。
lines.en: I pick you because you carry light.

lines.zh: 林子帮了我，它挡住你的退路。
lines.en: The forest helps me; it blocks your way out.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸变重了，虽然我并不呼吸。
lines.en: My breathing deepens, though I do not breathe.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡脸，那我就不打脸。
lines.en: You raise a hand to your face, so I aim elsewhere.

lines.zh: 袋子里的东西够我扔到你倒下。
lines.en: I have enough in this pouch to keep throwing until you drop.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝盖，那里跑不快。
lines.en: I stare at your knees; they cannot run fast.

lines.zh: 我隔着三棵树，也闻得到你。
lines.en: Even three trees away, I can smell you.

lines.zh: 我侧身站开，把重心压在左脚。
lines.en: I stand sideways with my weight on my left foot.

lines.zh: 手臂往后拉，肩上的烂肉跟着扯动。
lines.en: I draw my arm back and the flesh on my shoulder pulls.

lines.zh: 我心里数到三，才准备出手。
lines.en: I count to three in my head before I let go.

lines.zh: 你举盾的样子，我见过太多。
lines.en: I have seen too many people raise a shield like that.

lines.zh: 我瞄的是你的手，不是你的头。
lines.en: I aim at your hands, not your head.

lines.zh: 腐肉的汁顺着我的手腕往下走。
lines.en: Juice from the flesh runs down my wrist.

lines.zh: 树杈会挡住高处的线，我压低些。
lines.en: Branches block a high arc, so I aim lower.

lines.zh: 你往后退，我的手臂跟着送出去。
lines.en: You back away and my arm follows through.

lines.zh: 我嘴里发出低低的响声，像在磨牙。
lines.en: A low sound comes from my mouth, like grinding teeth.

lines.zh: 我等风停，风会让这东西偏。
lines.en: I wait for the wind to die; it would push this aside.

lines.zh: 我的手在抖，但我知道会中。
lines.en: My hand shakes, but I know it will land.

lines.zh: 这一下要越过你脚边的石块。
lines.en: This throw must clear the stones at your feet.

lines.zh: 我把手指扣进烂肉里，抓稳了。
lines.en: I dig my fingers into the flesh and grip it tight.

lines.zh: 你身后是空地，扔偏了也追得上。
lines.en: Open ground lies behind you, so a miss is still recoverable.

lines.zh: 我数你的步数，等你走到树缝。
lines.en: I count your steps, waiting for the gap between trees.

lines.zh: 袋子最后一块，我留着给你。
lines.en: The last piece in the bag is saved for you.

lines.zh: 我抬手时，你还没看见。
lines.en: My arm is up before you notice.

lines.zh: 我捏着腐肉，等你走到树空。
lines.en: I squeeze the rotten flesh, waiting for you to cross the gap.

lines.zh: 腐肉飞出去，撞在树干上又弹回来。
lines.en: The flesh flies out, hits a trunk, and bounces back.

lines.zh: 我砸中你的手臂，你的盾歪了。
lines.en: I hit your arm and your shield tips.

lines.zh: 你侧身躲开，烂肉糊在身后的树上。
lines.en: You dodge and the flesh splatters on the tree behind you.

lines.zh: 我上前一步，用肩膀撞你。
lines.en: I step in and drive my shoulder into you.

lines.zh: 我的手抓住你的领口，指甲陷进布。
lines.en: My hand catches your collar and my nails sink into cloth.

lines.zh: 你被推得撞上树，落叶落了一头。
lines.en: You are shoved into a tree and leaves rain on your head.

lines.zh: 我不喊，出手的时候只有风声。
lines.en: I do not shout; only wind sounds when I strike.

lines.zh: 我的拳头砸在你背上，很闷。
lines.en: My fist lands on your back with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 你的剑擦过我的肋骨，我照旧往前。
lines.en: Your blade grazes my ribs and I keep coming.

lines.zh: 我抓了一把土扬过去，然后才扔。
lines.en: I fling a handful of dirt first, then throw.

lines.zh: 我打空了，指节磕在树皮上。
lines.en: I miss and my knuckles crack against bark.

lines.zh: 这一下我用上了整个上身。
lines.en: I put my whole upper body into that blow.

lines.zh: 你退到灌木里，我跟着踩进去。
lines.en: You back into the brush and I step in after you.

lines.zh: 我把你按住，另一只手去摸袋子。
lines.en: I pin you down and my other hand reaches for the pouch.

lines.zh: 这块砸在你肩甲上，滑开了。
lines.en: This one hit your pauldron and skidded off.

lines.zh: 我冲上去抱住你的腰。
lines.en: I rush in and lock my arms around your waist.

lines.zh: 我从落叶堆里坐起来，身上全是土。
lines.en: I sit up out of the leaf litter, covered in soil.

lines.zh: 这里树太密，我站起来时撞到了枝。
lines.en: The trees are thick here; I hit a branch standing up.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己是怎么到这的，只知道有影子。
lines.en: I do not know how I got here, only that there was shade.

lines.zh: 我的手指先动，然后才是眼睛。
lines.en: My fingers move first, then my eyes.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道从我自己身上来。
lines.en: The smell of rotten flesh comes from my own body.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸口袋，土豆还在。
lines.en: I feel my pocket: the potatoes are still there.

lines.zh: 林子安静得能听见我骨头在响。
lines.en: The woods are quiet enough to hear my bones creak.

lines.zh: 我试着抬手臂，它比昨天沉。
lines.en: I try raising my arm; it is heavier than yesterday.

lines.zh: 我倒下过，现在又站起来了。
lines.en: I fell once; now I am standing again.

lines.zh: 一片苔藓长在我的膝上，我没弄掉。
lines.en: Moss grows on my knee and I leave it.

lines.zh: 我闻到远处有炊烟，就往那边走。
lines.en: I smell cooking smoke far off and head that way.

lines.zh: 我的影子在树间被切成好几段。
lines.en: My shadow is cut into pieces among the trees.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，喉咙里只有干的声音。
lines.en: I open my mouth and only a dry sound comes out.

lines.zh: 我记得这片林子，我在这丢过东西。
lines.en: I remember this forest; I lost something here.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我的皮就卷起来，像干树皮。
lines.en: Fire curls my skin like dry bark.

lines.zh: 我从树上摔下，落地时袋子先响。
lines.en: I fall from the tree and my pouch rattles on landing.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的喉咙，我居然还想喘气。
lines.en: Water pours down my throat and I still try to gasp.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀进树丛，腐肉撒了一地。
lines.en: The blast throws me into the brush and flesh scatters.

lines.zh: 箭插在我胸口，我把它拔出来扔了。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my chest; I pull it out and throw it.

lines.zh: 药水浇下来，我的皮开始冒烟发黑。
lines.en: Potion pours over me and my skin smokes and blackens.

lines.zh: 我饿得握不住东西，袋子还在响。
lines.en: Hunger loosens my grip, yet the pouch still rattles.

lines.zh: 雷劈中我身边的树，我半边身子麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the tree beside me and half my body numbs.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有树，我找不到可以靠的东西。
lines.en: There are no trees in the void, nothing to lean on.
